name_zh: 菲利普斯/荷兰/电子/灯泡/医疗/研发/家族企业/埃因霍温
description_zh: 杰拉德·菲利普斯 (1858-1942) 与儿子安东，从灯泡起家建立电子帝国，埃因霍温研发基地孵化医疗/照明/消费电子创新，家族企业治理平衡技术理想与商业现实，二战期间保护犹太员工，战后重建欧洲电子工业基石。
description_en: Gerard Philips (1858-1942) and son Anton, built electronics empire from lightbulbs, Eindhoven R&D base incubated medical/lighting/consumer electronics innovations, family enterprise governance balanced tech ideals and commercial reality, WWII protected Jewish employees, postwar rebuilt European electronics industry foundation.
reason_zh: 菲利普斯代表家族企业如何通过持续研发投入实现技术代际传承，展示了埃因霍温模式如何将城市转化为创新生态系统，其二战保护犹太员工展现企业社会责任，战后重建奠定欧洲电子工业基石。
reason_en: Philips represents how family enterprise achieves intergenerational tech inheritance through sustained R&D investment, demonstrating how Eindhoven model transforms city into innovation ecosystem, WWII Jewish employee protection demonstrating corporate social responsibility, postwar rebuilding European electronics foundation.
